$:set -euo pipefail
test -n "$GH_TOKEN"
gh codespace ssh -c shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96 -- env GH_TOKEN="$GH_TOKEN" bash -s <<'REMOTE_FILESYSTEM'
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspaces/Terminals
git fetch origin main
git rebase origin/main
auth_header=$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GH_TOKEN" | base64 -w0)
git -c "http.https://github.com/.extraheader=AUTHORIZATION: basic $auth_header" push origin HEAD:main
unset auth_header
printf '%s\n' '--- COMMIT ---'
git rev-parse HEAD
printf '%s\n' '--- STATUS ---'
git status --short | head -20
REMOTE_FILESYSTEM
